descFull: A highly specialized reverse-engineering pipeline designed to structurally transplant original Vanilla character models into the EverQuest Online Adventures: Frontiers (PS2) game engine, resolving complex Vector Unit 1 (VU1) shader bugs, Emotion Engine (EE) memory overflows, and PS2 CDVDman hardware faults.
